definition_text: Current practical Cluster 1 short proxy without extra timing delay.
Wait one completed 5m candle after the base signal and enter only if the Cluster 1 short zone still looks valid.
Wait up to two completed 5m candles and enter only if there is no meaningful continuation above the signal high while the zone still looks valid.
Wait up to two completed 5m candles and enter only on a simple weakening / failed-continuation style candle while the zone still looks valid.
